evidence.title: Anger over Cornell's handling of rape allegations turns toward its president

occurrences.checkable_against: Cornell faculty senate resolution and vote records
occurrences.quote_span: The Cornell faculty senate indicated that it plans to vote on a resolution of no confidence in the school’s administrators.
occurrences.speaker: Cornell faculty senate
occurrences.subject: Cornell University faculty no-confidence resolution over administration handling of alleged sexual assault

evidence.title: Cornell faculty senate introduces no-confidence resolution over handling of alleged 2024 sexual assault

occurrences.checkable_against: Statement accompanying the Cornell faculty resolution
occurrences.quote_span: Cornell alumni had also contacted faculty members and shared “their own traumatic stories as students,” the statement added.
occurrences.speaker: Faculty sponsors of the Cornell resolution
occurrences.subject: Cornell University faculty no-confidence resolution over administration handling of alleged sexual assault

occurrences.checkable_against: Cornell University response to NBC News request for comment
occurrences.quote_span: Cornell declined to comment.
occurrences.speaker: Cornell University
occurrences.subject: Cornell University faculty no-confidence resolution over administration handling of alleged sexual assault

occurrences.checkable_against: Cornell University faculty resolution and University Faculty Committee records
occurrences.quote_span: Cornell University faculty introduced a resolution declaring a no-confidence vote in the university administration’s handling of the alleged 2024 sexual assault at a fraternity house.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Cornell University faculty no-confidence resolution over administration handling of alleged sexual assault

occurrences.checkable_against: Cornell Faculty Senate vote and subsequent faculty-leadership policy discussions
occurrences.quote_span: If the Faculty Senate passes the resolution, Brady said, it will then prompt a series of discussions between faculty and Cornell’s leadership for policies affecting sexual assault.
occurrences.speaker: Anne Marie Elizabeth Brady
occurrences.subject: Cornell University faculty no-confidence resolution over administration handling of alleged sexual assault

occurrences.checkable_against: Statement accompanying the Cornell faculty resolution
occurrences.quote_span: In a statement accompanying the resolution, the faculty sponsors said “numerous Cornell colleagues” had approached them demanding action, while students had told faculty they were “upset, fearful for their personal safety,” and wanted the Ivy League school to address sexual assault on campus.
occurrences.speaker: Faculty sponsors of the Cornell resolution
occurrences.subject: Cornell University faculty no-confidence resolution over administration handling of alleged sexual assault

occurrences.checkable_against: Cornell University Faculty Senate meeting calendar and resolution agenda
occurrences.quote_span: The measure is expected to be considered by the faculty senate, which meets Oct. 14, according to a statement from faculty senator Paul Ortiz.
occurrences.speaker: Paul Ortiz
occurrences.subject: Cornell University faculty no-confidence resolution over administration handling of alleged sexual assault

occurrences.checkable_against: Statement by Cornell faculty senator Paul Ortiz
occurrences.quote_span: He reiterated that the senate was not “targeting any individual” but that the students and faculty “have been unsatisfied with the response.”
occurrences.speaker: Paul Ortiz
occurrences.subject: Cornell University faculty no-confidence resolution over administration handling of alleged sexual assault

occurrences.checkable_against: Text of Cornell faculty no-confidence resolution
occurrences.quote_span: “That the Faculty Senate has no confidence in the ability of the central administration to effectively address the ongoing crisis of sexual assault at Cornell University,” the resolution, which is less than half a page, says.
occurrences.speaker: Cornell University faculty resolution
occurrences.subject: Cornell University faculty no-confidence resolution over administration handling of alleged sexual assault

occurrences.checkable_against: Cornell University University Faculty Committee submission records and resolution copy
occurrences.quote_span: The resolution was submitted to the University Faculty Committee on Monday evening, according to a copy obtained by NBC News.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Cornell University faculty no-confidence resolution over administration handling of alleged sexual assault

occurrences.checkable_against: Statement by Cornell faculty senator Paul Ortiz
occurrences.quote_span: Ortiz added that “students have been telling us stories they don’t feel safe, and this has been going on for a number of years” and called the situation a “systemic problem.”
occurrences.speaker: Paul Ortiz
occurrences.subject: Cornell University faculty no-confidence resolution over administration handling of alleged sexual assault

occurrences.checkable_against: Statement by Cornell faculty senator Paul Ortiz
occurrences.quote_span: He reiterated that the senate was not “targeting any individual” but that the students and faculty “have been unsatisfied with the response.”
occurrences.speaker: Paul Ortiz
occurrences.subject: Cornell University faculty no-confidence resolution over administration handling of alleged sexual assault

occurrences.checkable_against: Cornell University Faculty Senate meeting calendar and resolution agenda
occurrences.quote_span: The measure is expected to be considered by the faculty senate, which meets Oct. 14, according to a statement from faculty senator Paul Ortiz.
occurrences.speaker: Paul Ortiz
occurrences.subject: Cornell University faculty no-confidence resolution over administration handling of alleged sexual assault

occurrences.checkable_against: Cornell Faculty Senate resolution drafting and submission records
occurrences.quote_span: Anne Marie Elizabeth Brady, a Faculty Senate member and research director for the university’s Industrial and Labor Relations Workers Institute, said the resolution came together “quickly” in recent days.
